featured_reviews.name: Jeshma Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text: Arnold hosted my roce ceremony and wedding reception. Having known Arnold for a couple of years now and seeing how he gets the crowd engaged and entertained, we knew we had to book him. He was great and did his job very well. Would definitely recommend choosing him to host events.

featured_reviews.name: Nigel Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
We are so glad we chose Arnold Lobo as the emcee for our wedding celebration. He was absolutely superb from start to finish!

Arnold brought the perfect balance of energy, warmth, and elegance to the event. He kept the flow seamless, engaged our guests beautifully, and ensured everyone felt included and entertained. So many of our family members and friends personally told us how much they enjoyed his compering — that truly says it all.

What we appreciated the most was his incredible presence of mind. There was a moment when my wife and I didn’t want to be on stage for the wishing — we wanted to spend that time dancing and being with our family. At the same time, our family needed a few extra minutes to prepare the thank-you return gift bags. Arnold handled the entire situation so smoothly and naturally, stepping in and managing everything effortlessly without making it awkward or noticeable. That kind of intuition, sensitivity, and professionalism is truly rare.

And when it came to the dance floor — he absolutely nailed it! He even taught us some fun dance moves and kept the energy so high that the dance floor stayed full till the DJ had to sign off. That kind of vibe is something you can’t force — it takes real talent and experience.

He didn’t just host our event — he elevated it.

Thank you, Arnold, for making our celebration even more special. We would highly recommend him to anyone looking for a classy, confident, energetic, and thoughtful emcee in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: Ryan Fernandes
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

If you’re searching for a host who can turn your event into an unforgettable experience, look no further than Arnold! From the moment he grabbed the mic at our reception, it was clear we were in for a treat. Imagine a master conductor orchestrating a symphony of laughter, joy, and just the right amount of chaos - that's Arnold!

He didn’t just host our event, he elevated it to an entirely new level of fabulousness. Arnold has a unique ability to make everyone feel included, from the shyest wallflower to the life of the party.

If you want your function to be as memorable as ours, book Arnold. Just be prepared—he might steal the show! Thank you, Arnold, for making our day extraordinary!

featured_reviews.name: Bianca Dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
We had an absolutely wonderful experience with Arnold as the anchor for our twin babies’ baptism. From start to finish, he ensured a smooth and well-managed event flow and anchored the entire ceremony beautifully.
So many of our guests personally came up to us to appreciate how kind, joyful, and engaging he was. He kept everyone involved throughout and handled every moment with such ease and professionalism. Even when we faced lighting issues, Arnold managed everything effortlessly—right from coordinating the first dance with our babies to keeping the crowd comfortable and engaged.
What truly stood out was his calm presence and positivity. He kept lifting my spirits and reminding me to cheer up, which meant a lot on such an emotional day.
On behalf of myself, my husband, our babies, and our entire family, we are extremely grateful to have Arnold host this joyous celebration. Everyone loved his hosting, and we honestly couldn’t have asked for a better anchor for such a special occasion. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: M D
featured_reviews.review_text:
Arnold did a fantabulous job as emcee for both my roce and wedding reception party in January 26. It was a last minute request and we were lucky that he was available for both the events.
For the roce, not only did he guide us and help us get organized with the event flow, he also kept the everything going smoothly with no awkward moments throughout the evening. He kept the energy levels up right till the end!

Our family were thrilled with the way all our guests were kept engaged through the wedding reception party. Ours was a smaller indoor hall but Arnold still led us through the wedding march seamlessly and our guests had so much fun. When dancing too his energy is infectious, he made everyone want to stay on the dance floor. He has got some really good moves, and taught us some too! We were unprepared for our first dance but he taught us a few moves a few minutes before our entry, so we were good to go..
From tiny toddlers to my husband's 96 year old grandpa, everyone had a memorable and fantastic time.
I'd wholeheartedly recommend Arnold because he is one of THE best emcees out there! Thanks Arnold, you did a terrific job! 😀💯

featured_reviews.name: sharon dsouza
featured_reviews.review_text:
Arnold hosted both my Roce and Wedding, and he was absolutely amazing! His energy, warmth, and natural joy lit up the entire celebration. Many of my family members even asked if he was part of our family because of how effortlessly he connected with everyone and joined in the fun on the dance floor.

I had only one request for my big day — that I wanted to dance and have everyone dance with me — and Arnold made it happen! He ensured every single person was on the dance floor, creating memories we’ll cherish forever. Truly one of the best emcees I’ve seen — professional, lively, and full of heart!

With lots of love,
Sharon & Ankit

featured_reviews.name: nikhil pinto
featured_reviews.review_text:
We cannot thank Arnold enough for the incredible energy he brought to our wedding 💙
He has a unique talent for getting a crowd moving while keeping the atmosphere feeling intimate and personal.
He organized a surprise for us that was so beautiful and heart-touching; it really showed how much care he puts into his work ✨
Even when things didn't go perfectly on our end (like forgetting our blindfolds for the bridal kiss!), Arnold didn't miss a beat. He came up with a brilliant alternative on the spot that had everyone laughing and cheering.
Arnold is truly a master of his craft and has set the bar incredibly high. If you can book him, do it! We wish him nothing but the best in his career 💫
